title: form.submit raises TypeError when running a bulk import
body:
## Environment

Running Lattice 3.3.2 on macOS 15.3 against eu-west-2.

## Steps

To reproduce:
* Open Lattice and begin running a bulk import.
* Use an input with an odd number of rows.
* Watch the log for the traceback below.

## Expected

No traceback; running a bulk import normally takes a few
seconds.

## Actual

Every row works except the last row, which raises. Adding a
line moves the failure to the new last row.

## Frequency

Reproduces twice this week.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:51 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:93 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:56 in run_import
lattice/ui/form.py:257 in submit
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
